The WAV passed format checks and reached ASR 9.7758 with 0.982 coverage, but the opening It'll grow was decoded as It took Ro, so first words, ordered content, missing-content, duplicate-content, and unexpected-content gates failed. No listening, expansion, upload, or publication followed. All evaluated local families remain closed and Gift still requires exact source-bound delivery.
the-gift-of-the-magi.audiobook_next_action: Keep Gift audio-hidden. Do not repeat the CosyVoice3 fingerprint or spend on its listening QA. Accept only a complete exact source-bound narration or licensed-audio delivery through the existing packet, then run full ASR, listening, measured-sync, checksum, metadata, endpoint, and browser gates.

picture-of-dorian-gray.decision_reason: The canonical and backend controlled roots produce the same exact source, the title has no recorded prior provider attempt, and a title-specific Charon 0.94 dry preflight produced a new four-passage fingerprint. Canonical covers remain empty; the historical pair is keyed to a different slug and cannot be adopted without exact-title audit and checksum-bound promotion.

frankenstein.audiobook_next_action: Reconcile the canonical/backend source divergence and checksum-promote a reviewed exact-title cover pair. Then admit at most one source-bound Charon representative candidate through objective and listening QA.

white-fang.decision_reason: The canonical and backend controlled roots produce the same exact source and the title has no recorded prior provider attempt. A title-specific Charon 0.94 dry preflight produced a new four-passage fingerprint, but no canonical or retained exact cover pair exists.

dracula.decision_reason: All 27 canonical chapter records now carry the deterministic dracula bookSlug metadata without changing content or stored content_hash. The English input builder converts only supported p/br reader HTML and proves the canonical and backend roots produce the same exact 848683-character, 27-chapter normalized manuscript hash; unsupported tags and any root divergence fail closed.
dracula.audiobook_next_action: Run the exact source-freeze command recorded in the parity evidence, review the deterministic input manifest, and only then admit one title-specific representative candidate through the normal objective and listening gates.

pride-and-prejudice.decision_reason: The exact rights-clear, source-bound Chatterbox V3 sample rendered valid private media, but medium.en and an independent small.en adjudication both substituted canonical Long with Wong. Score 9.7872 cannot override coverage 0.9787 below 0.98, missing and unexpected content, or failed ordered-content integrity.
pride-and-prejudice.canonical_text_rights_basis: Jane Austen died in 1817 and Pride and Prejudice was published in 1813; the controlled source evidence records public-domain commercial use.
pride-and-prejudice.audiobook_next_action: Keep Pride audio hidden and do not repeat the closed Chatterbox V3 fingerprint. Require one genuinely different exact source-bound delivery, then rerun objective ASR, coverage, first/last, and ordered-content gates before any listening spend.

the-tell-tale-heart.decision_reason: The exact Redon-derived 1600 x 2400 front/back pair passed full and thumbnail review, public-domain rights verification, private content-addressed upload, remote checksum verification, and atomic mirrored canonical promotion. The failed CosyVoice3 audio fingerprint remains closed and audio remains hidden.
the-tell-tale-heart.audiobook_next_action: Keep audio hidden and do not repeat the closed CosyVoice3 fingerprint. Admit only a materially different exact-source pilot with deterministic sentence-safe chunking and exact reconstruction before any full-title generation.
